sources.exophase: Exophase — official GTA VI trophy list (names, descriptions, grades)
sources.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (PlayStation's tracked counts)
sources.own: Our own advice, written from the official description — not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Work the roadmap in order: story first, the missable moments when they come, then strangers, activities, collectibles and the money grinds. The last step is usually A Long Road (100% completion), so keep the 100% checklist in view as you play.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy: it unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. You cannot miss it — just play the story. The mission introduces Lucia and Jason, so treat it as the tutorial: learn the controls here and the rest of the roadmap gets easier.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Automatic — it pops when the chapter ends. There is no missable step inside it; keep playing and it comes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Automatic — it pops when the chapter ends. Play the chapter's missions in order and it comes on its own.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Automatic — it pops when the chapter ends. No side content is needed for it; the story alone carries you here.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Automatic — it pops when the chapter ends. By now the missable moments are mostly behind you; check the Missables page before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy (gold) for finishing the final mission. Automatic once the story ends — nothing extra to do, and it cannot be missed. Finish the story before the big collectible grind, so every story trophy is banked before cleanup begins.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. Play it when the story offers it — there is no reason to delay it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. Heist missions are the story's set pieces — enjoy it, then move on to the next chapter.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. It unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. Take it as it comes in the story order.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. It unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. Nothing in the official description asks for anything beyond finishing the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. The airport setting matters for a different trophy — Catch Me If You Can — so keep that one in mind while you are at VCIA.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed. Play it when the story offers it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for 100% completion. This is the real endgame: the game's own 100% checklist (story, strangers, activities, collectibles) must all be done. Track it with the roadmap here — every stage feeds it. Nothing in the official description says any part is missable, but do the missable moments on your first pass so nothing is left behind.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, wheelies and whatever else the game counts as a stunt. The official description gives only the count (250); it does not name which moves count, so experiment and watch the counter climb. A steady trickle across the whole playthrough beats a grind at the end: stunt whenever you drive.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — PlayStation tracks 9 types. The official description does not list the 9, so treat this as a tour: fishing, the shooting range, races, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest the game offers. One try each is enough; you do not need to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The count (42) is from the official list; the challenges themselves are the range's own drills. Gold every drill — repeat one until the gold score lands — and do the range early, so your aim is sharp for the story missions that follow.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 of them. Win one race per location; the official description does not name the locations, so open the map and work through the drone race markers one by one until all 14 are won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, drone or any other race type the game offers. Vary your races rather than repeating one: the word 'different' is doing the work here.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — the official description names no spot, so look for Cal where the game puts its fishing challenges. One win is enough.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — finish one full game at an arcade cabinet. Any cabinet counts; pick the shortest game you can finish cleanly.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Stranger missions unlock as you meet Andy around Leonida — follow his strand to its end. Nothing in the official description says it is missable, so take it when it appears.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Follow Kenton's stranger strand to its end — the final mission is the payoff. Nothing in the official description says it is missable, so take it when it appears.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its end. Nothing in the official description says it is missable, so take it when it appears.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Meet strangers (the '?' encounters) and finish their whole strands — 8 complete strands, not 8 missions. Keep an eye on the map for stranger markers as you explore; the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each count toward the 8.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's stranger strand to its end. Nothing in the official description says it is missable, so take it when it appears.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its end. Nothing in the official description says it is missable, so take it when it appears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. The official description gives the count but no map, so treat it as a tour: meditation spots are the quiet viewpoints the game marks. One session per spot.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a stranger strand — follow it until the unique animal is the target, then take it down. The official description does not name the animal or the place, so let Bret's missions lead you there.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when every card in it is found. Work from a card checklist and sweep the map area by area — this is a long grind, best done after the story.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's in-world photo and share activity — do it at 100 different spots. The description gives the count (100) but no list, so spread it out: WAiNK It wherever you go and the count climbs on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — the official description counts 50, without naming them. Do challenges as they come up in normal play; check the challenge list often so you are not grinding the last few blind.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the heat to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. Use the map's edges and the water to break the search.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three robberies in one wanted run — plan a route past three shops, keep moving, and do not let the level drop between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles — the game logs each new one. Variety is the whole job: grab anything you have not driven yet, including boats and bikes.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded fight, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. Pick a mission or shootout with plenty of enemies grouped together.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (the airport). The official description reads like a one-time airport moment — an unscheduled departure, not a scheduled flight — so treat it as missable: when the chance to leave VCIA off-schedule comes, take it, because it may not come again. The game released today and no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so this flag is our reading of the description, not a verified walkthrough.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the description is a joke about tanks. Expect a Rhino tank encounter (story or free roam) and deal with it: survive it, steal it or destroy it as the moment demands. The official description does not spell out the trigger, so take the tank moment when it appears.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses calling it in. Case the store first, move when the staff are not looking, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. It can be retried if you are spotted, so it is not missable — just patient.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault jobs, each ending with a clean escape. Plan each one like a heist: get in, crack the vault, get out before the response arrives.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, crack it open and get clear. Trucks run set routes — wait for one on a quiet stretch rather than chasing one through traffic.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. The official description counts 52 areas; the game does not list them, so explore systematically: every town, beach, swamp and back road. The area counter is your guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. Find each gang's illegal operation and hit it. The description gives the count (9) but names no gang or place, so work the map gang by gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet moment, not a fight: have a cocktail somewhere with an Ocean Beach view. The wording ('In The Beginning…') reads like an early-game, one-time moment, so do it when the game first offers it rather than saving it for later. The game released today and no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so this flag is our reading of the description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The description sounds like a scripted story beat — a showroom escape, done loudly. Treat it as a one-time moment: when a mission puts you in a showroom, smash out rather than walking out. The game released today and no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so this flag is our reading of the description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley — the official description names the place (Kolt & Associates), which is rare in this list, so go there. One game is enough.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it reads like a one-off partnership moment. When a story or stranger beat offers a public, crowd-pleasing partnership moment, take it; it may not repeat. The game released today and no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so this flag is our reading of the description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this one — choices, made repeatedly. The description implies decisions across the game count toward it, so make choices when they are offered and do not reload to undo them: the count may only move forward. Flagged missable because a choice, once passed, may not come back.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description implies succeeding on a second try at something — a second attempt that lands. When something fails once, try it again right away: the trophy is about the retry, not the first attempt. The game released today and no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so this flag is our reading of the description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange event — the description reads like a one-off encounter with something weird. Keep your eyes open for the odd and the unexplained as you explore; when something strange happens, the trophy should follow. The game released today and no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so this flag is our reading of the description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass and swing as you go by — speed helps less than aim.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from jobs; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It is a slow money grind — keep laundering as you earn, and it finishes during normal play.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy cars, clothes, weapons, food — everything counts. The counter is cumulative, so normal spending across the game adds up; save the big purchases for the end if you want to control when it pops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them. Garages are bought with cash; buy all 8. Save money for them or buy as you go — either way, the last one pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register vehicles you own or find — 10 registrations. Keep registering new rides as you discover them.
